questions.analysis_html: \begin{aligned} \text{设} \, (X,Y) \text{ 的分布函数为 } F(x,y), \text{ 则} \quad & F(x,y) = P\bigl\{ X \leq x, Y \leq y \bigr\} = P\bigl\{ X \leq x, Y \leq y \bigr\} = \int_{-x}^{x} f(x) dx \int_{-x}^{y} g(y) dy \, , \\ \text{其中, } \, f(x) = & \begin{cases} 1, \ 0 \leq x \leq 1 \\ 0, \ \text{其它} \end{cases}, \ \ g(y) = \begin{cases} 1, \ 0 \leq y \leq 1 \\ 0, \ \text{其它} \end{cases}, \\ \text{故当 } 0 \leq x \leq 1 \text{ 且 } 0 \leq y \leq 1 \text{ 时，有} \quad & f(x,y) = \frac{\partial^2 F(x,y)}{\partial_x \partial_y} = 1 \\ \text{而在此区域外都有 } f(x,y) = 0, \text{ 因此} \, (X,Y) \text{ 为区域 } 0 \leq x \leq 1, \ 0 \leq y \leq 1 \text{ 上服从均匀分布的二维随机变量.} \end{aligned}

questions.analysis_html: \begin{aligned}&\text{按定义}\qquad F_{\lambda}(Z)=P\{x+2y\leq z\},\\&\text{当}z\leq 0\text{时，}F_{\lambda}(Z)=\iint\limits_{x+2y\leq z}f(x,y)dx dy=\iint\limits_{x+2y\leq z}0dx dy=0.\\&\text{当}z>0\text{时，}F_{\lambda}(Z)=\iint\limits_{x+2y\leq z}f(x,y)dx dy=\int_{0}^{z}dx\int_{0}^{z-x(z)^{2}}2e^{-(x+z)}dy\\&\qquad=\int_{0}^{z}e^{-z}\cdot(1-e^{-z}-1)dx=\int_{0}^{z}(e^{-z}-e^{-z})dx\\&\qquad=[-e^{-z}]_{0}^{z}-ze^{-z}=1-e^{-z}-ze^{-z},\\&\text{故分布函数为}\qquad F_{\lambda}(Z)=\begin{cases}0,&z\leq 0\\1-e^{-z}-ze^{-z},z>0\end{cases}.\end{aligned}

questions.analysis_html:
\begin{aligned}F_{\lambda}(z)&=P\{Z\leq z\}=P\{\sqrt{X^2+Y^2}\leq z\}.\\ \text{当}z<0\text{时},\ F_{\lambda}(z)&=P(\varnothing)=0;\\ \text{当}z\geq 0\text{时},\\ F_{\lambda}(z)&=P\{X^2+Y^2\leq z^2\}=\iint\limits_{x^2+y^2\leq z^2}f(x,y)dx dy\\&=\frac{1}{2\pi}\iint\limits_{x^2+y^2\leq z^2}e^{-\frac{x^2+y^2}{2}}dx dy=\frac{1}{2\pi}\int_{0}^{2\pi}d\theta\int_{0}^{\pi}e^{-\frac{\rho^2}{2}}\rho d\rho\\&=\int_{0}^{\pi}e^{-\frac{\rho^2}{2}}\rho d\rho=1-e^{-\frac{z^2}{2}}.\end{aligned}
故 Z的分布函数为
F_{\lambda}(z)=\begin{cases}1-e^{-\frac{z^2}{2}},\,z\geq 0,\\0,\qquad z<0\end{cases}
Z的分布密度为
f_{\lambda}(z)=\begin{cases}ze^{-\frac{z^2}{2}},\,z>0,\\0,\qquad z\leq 0\end{cases}

questions.prompt_html: \text{设随机变量}X\text{与}Y\text{相互独立，}X-U[-\pi,\pi],Y\sim N(\mu,\sigma^{2}),\text{则}Z=X+Y\text{的概率密度为}().

options.label: A
options.html: \begin{aligned}\frac{1}{2\pi} \bigg[ \Phi \bigg( \frac{z+\pi-\mu}{\sigma} \bigg) - \Phi \bigg( \frac{z-\pi-\mu}{\sigma} \bigg) \bigg]\end{aligned}

questions.analysis_html: \begin{aligned}&\text{因为}X,Y\text{是相互独立的，故} \\&f(x,y)=f_{x}(x)f_{y}(y)=\begin{cases}\displaystyle\frac{1}{2\pi}\frac{1}{\sqrt{2\pi\sigma}}e^{-\frac{(y-\mu)^{2}}{2\sigma^{2}}},-\pi\leq x\leq\pi,-\infty<y<+\infty,\\0,\quad\text{其它}\end{cases}\\&\text{而}\quad f(z)=\int_{-\infty}^{+\infty}f(z-y,y)dy=\displaystyle\frac{1}{2\pi}\int_{z-\pi}^{+\pi}\frac{1}{\sqrt{2\pi\sigma}}e^{-\frac{(y-\mu)^{2}}{2\sigma^{2}}}dy=\displaystyle\frac{1}{2\pi}\left[\Phi\left(\frac{z+\pi-\mu}{\sigma}\right)-\Phi\left(\frac{z-\pi-\mu}{\sigma}\right)\right].\end{aligned}
